# WeatherPets

> WeatherPets (Weather Pets) is an iOS weather app that turns your real pet into your personal weather reporter — AI-generated weather scenes featuring your pet, accurate hourly and 10-day forecasts via Apple WeatherKit, severe weather alerts, morning and evening pet weather reports, and home screen widgets. Built by Relative Industries, LLC.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/weatherpets-weather-widgets/id6759507221

## Quick answers

- **What is WeatherPets?** An iOS weather app that turns your own dog or cat into your personal weather reporter, pairing your pet with your real local forecast; premium adds AI-generated weather scenes of your pet.
- **How does it work?** Add one photo of your pet and pick a few personality traits; the app generates scenes of your pet dressed for the real weather and delivers the forecast in their voice via reports and home screen widgets.
- **Is it free?** Free to download; the free version uses your pet's own photos with real weather. Premium (monthly or annual) unlocks AI-generated scenes of your pet, widgets, style packs, and multiple pets.
- **What weather data does it use?** Apple Weather (WeatherKit): accurate current conditions, hourly and 10-day forecasts, and severe weather alerts.
- **What devices?** iPhone on iOS 17 or later, including home screen and lock screen widgets.
- **Who makes it?** Relative Industries, LLC (founders Dom and Adam).
